# Cully 0.18.0

- **One setup for every project.** `cully setup` now installs everything in your agent's user configuration (`~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.cursor`, honoring their config-directory overrides): hooks, the Cully skill, the `/cully` command or prompt, MCP registration and Codex guidance. Run it once from any directory; it never creates a `.cully` folder, edits `AGENTS.md` or adds Cursor commands in the repository you run it from.
- **Detection and uninstall ignore the repository.** Agents are found from installed executables and user configuration. `cully uninstall` removes only Cully's managed user-level files and preserves your own instructions, commands and skills. An existing `AGENTS.override.md` in Codex's directory is respected.
- **Project memory is unchanged.** Sessions still derive project identity from the active repository, and memory stays owner-scoped; installing globally does not combine unrelated projects.
- **One Enter turns advice into action.** In the advisor drawer, Enter now adds a ready-made request to your coding agent's prompt. For configuration advice, such as setting up a tool the advisor found by analysing your session and researching the web, the request includes the measured signals and source link and tells the agent to inspect first, make the smallest repository change, ask before installing or using the network or credentials, never touch secrets, then verify and explain how to undo. It is pasted, not sent, so you review it first. Cully no longer writes project files from the drawer.
- **Advisor setup requests outside the terminal.** `cully suggestions --request N` prints the same guarded setup request for a numbered suggestion, so agents in T3 Code or any chat client can offer it. The Cully skill tells them to.
- **Cully as a plugin.** Add Cully's hooks and skill from Claude Code's, Cursor's or Codex's plugin marketplace instead of `cully setup` (use one route per agent). The plugins run the same hooks as setup, and tests keep them identical. Claude Code's own validator checks its plugin; Cursor and Codex follow their documented formats and are untested in a live agent. See [install as a plugin](https://docs.cully.net/plugins).
- **Docs refreshed.** README, installation, agents, quickstart and website describe the user-wide setup and its file locations.

Install the CLI with `cully update --version v0.18.0`, or rerun the [installer](https://docs.cully.net/installation). Refresh managed hooks and skills with `cully setup` using your original options. Memory services need no schema change.
